The fixture is a projection of the public response observed on 2026-10-31:

https://data.gov.hr/ckan/api/3/action/package_show?id=slobodna-radna-mjesta-po-zanimanju

It keeps only the dataset name and resource ID, name, description, URL, format
and state. At observation time there were 18 active XML resources, labelled in
`description`; `name` was null. The labels do not describe the feeds' content:
each live feed holds a different HZZ category than its label names, and four
feeds had not changed since early 2024.
